data.one_liner: On-device speech recognition and transcription using WhisperKit on iOS and macOS
data.what_it_does: Provides on-device speech-to-text transcription using Whisper models. It supports real-time microphone transcription, audio file transcription, model downloads, language detection, and type-safe error handling.
use_when: You need on-device speech-to-text transcription without sending data to external servers
You are building iOS or macOS applications that require multilingual speech recognition
You need real-time streaming transcription or audio file processing
avoid_when: You need support for Android or other non-Apple platforms
You want a lightweight package without large machine learning model sizes
strengths: Complete on-device processing ensuring user privacy
Multiple model sizes available ranging from tiny to large
Provides stream-based real-time transcription and progress tracking
weaknesses: Android platform support is only planned for the future
Large model files require significant device storage and download time
data.setup_notes: Requires iOS 16.0+ or macOS 13.0+, configuring NSMicrophoneUsageDescription and folder permissions in Info.plist, and setting the macOS deployment target to 13.0+.
